card.name: Partway through dose numbers and drug names
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a unit, number or brand/generic drug name in dosing text, such as the 'mc' of mcg, the 'V' in a brand name, or a digit inside a dose or section number. Also fires on 'underestimate' in dose-conversion advice.

modes.label: Underestimate in dose advice
modes.description: The word underestimate in advice about totaling a daily dose.

card.writes: It suppresses words like measured and estimated, so it seems to steer away from estimation wording.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of dose numbers, units and drug names in dosing text, and on the word underestimate.
